Lulu.escape: Lulu has no dash to get herself out, so your chance to engage comes after Lulu W Whimsy is used on another ally. If Lulu E Help, Pix!'s shield and Lulu P Pix, Faerie Companion are on her allied carry, target Lulu herself.
Lulu.build: Weather the early game with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Lulu’s damage is mostly magic and Rell’s magic resistance is on the low side, so build magic resistance first and buy Spirit Visage earlier.
Lulu.combo: Use Rell E Full Tilt to close in with an ally, then knock the target up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. Follow with Rell Q Shattering Strike to stun them and Rell R Magnet Storm to pull them in. If you expect Lulu E Help, Pix!'s shield, don’t use Rell Q Shattering Strike early; time it for when the shield comes up.
Lulu.fight: When Lulu W Whimsy is down and your allies can follow up, close the gap with Rell E Full Tilt and knock the target up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. Once you’re on them, weave in basic attacks in your armored stance to keep Rell P Break the Mold stacks up. If Lulu E Help, Pix!'s shield comes up, break it with Rell Q Shattering Strike.
Lulu.laning: Stand behind minions to reduce the extra damage from Lulu P Pix, Faerie Companion. Pull the wave toward your allied turret and use a bush to catch the moment an enemy enters Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down range.
Lulu.phase: In the late game, it’s hard to get back out after engaging, so don’t go in alone.
Lulu.teamfight: Engage when your allies are ready to follow up and at least two enemies are in Rell R Magnet Storm range. Knock them up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, then pull them together with Rell R Magnet Storm so your allies can hit them with area damage. If the enemy team is spread out or only a target that would be protected by Lulu R Wild Growth is in sight, delay the engage and peel in front of your allied carries.
Lulu.watch: If Lulu W Whimsy is available, engaging with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down can be shut down, so go in after Lulu uses W on another ally. Lulu R Wild Growth saves its target and knocks up nearby enemies, so don’t dive deep assuming a target with R available is a guaranteed kill.

Alistar.phase: Later in the game, you have no way to get back out if you go in alone, so engage only when your team can follow.
Alistar.fight: Engage with your team using Rell E Full Tilt right after Alistar W Headbutt and Q Pulverize are down. After knocking him up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, stun him with Rell Q Shattering Strike and keep attacking in heavy armor. When Alistar R Unbreakable Will is active, hold your damage and back off before fighting again.
Alistar.teamfight: When your team is ready to follow and at least two enemies are in Rell R Magnet Storm range, knock them up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, then pull them together with R. While Alistar R Unbreakable Will is active, don’t spend your damage on Alistar; target the carries behind him. New crowd control still affects Alistar after he activates R, so if you can’t disengage, interrupt his engage with Rell Q Shattering Strike or W Ferromancy: Crash Down.
Alistar.watch: Alistar W Headbutt knocks you back, and Alistar Q Pulverize knocks you up, so don’t force an engage while both are available. Near your turret, don’t give Alistar room to circle behind you and force you under the turret.
Alistar.build: Alistar’s main damage is magic, and Rell has low magic resistance early, so start with Null-Magic Mantle to help you hold on. Choose Mercury’s Treads, and rush Spirit Visage if the enemy team also deals mostly magic damage.
Alistar.combo: When Alistar W Headbutt is down, speed in with your team using Rell E Full Tilt, then knock him up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. Stun him immediately with Rell Q Shattering Strike to trigger Rell E Full Tilt’s detonation as well, then pull him in with Rell R Magnet Storm to stop his escape.
Alistar.escape: Alistar W Headbutt is his mobility tool, so right after making him use it is Rell’s chance to engage. If Alistar Q Pulverize is also down, close the distance with Rell E Full Tilt and W Ferromancy: Crash Down, then lock him down with Q Shattering Strike and R Magnet Storm.
Alistar.laning: Pull the wave toward your turret and look for the moment Alistar enters Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down range from the brush. While Alistar W Headbutt and Q Pulverize are down, push the lane or reposition.

Ashe.build: Ashe’s main damage is physical, so build armor first with Plated Steelcaps. Her damage relies on basic attacks and attack speed, so Frozen Heart lowers her attack speed and protects your carries too. Remember that Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow deals magic damage and can’t be blocked by armor.
Ashe.combo: Approach with your team using Rell E Full Tilt, then knock Ashe up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. Stun her immediately with Rell Q Shattering Strike, trigger E’s detonation, then pull her in with Rell R Magnet Storm.
Ashe.escape: Ashe has no skill that creates distance, so engage when Ashe W Volley is down and Ashe Q Ranger’s Focus has ended. If Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is available, account for the stun risk and don’t start a fight from out of vision. To approach, use Rell E Full Tilt and W Ferromancy: Crash Down to reduce the time you spend walking through Ashe P Frost Shot’s slow.
Ashe.fight: Trade after Ashe W Volley is down and Ashe Q Ranger’s Focus has ended. Don’t spend too long walking toward her while slowed; speed in with your team using Rell E Full Tilt and close to Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down range. After knocking her up, weave in basic attacks in heavy armor to maintain Rell P Break the Mold stacks.
Ashe.laning: Pull the wave toward your turret and use the brush to look for the moment Ashe enters Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down range. The moment Ashe W Volley is down is your chance to trade.
Ashe.phase: Later in the game, Rell’s short range makes it hard to get back out after engaging alone, so move with your team.
Ashe.teamfight: When your team is ready to follow and at least two enemies are in Rell R Magnet Storm range, engage and pull them together. Use R immediately after knocking them up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down to create an opening for your team’s area damage. If the enemies are spread out, don’t go in on Ashe alone; stay in heavy armor in front of your carries and absorb the dive.
Ashe.watch: Dodge Ashe W Volley’s cone slow by moving sideways. Ashe P Frost Shot’s slow is refreshed with every basic attack, making it hard to walk away, so don’t stay within her attack range for long. Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow stuns, so don’t start a small fight from out of vision while her ultimate is available.

Blitzcrank.combo: Speed in with your team using Rell E Full Tilt, then stun the target with Rell Q Shattering Strike immediately after knocking them up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. Follow with Rell R Magnet Storm to pull them together. If Blitzcrank P Mana Barrier is about to appear, hold Rell Q Shattering Strike until the shield comes up, then use it to break the shield.
Blitzcrank.laning: Keep minions in front of you and use a Control Ward to secure vision in the brush. Keep your distance from brushes without vision. Pull the wave toward your turret, then trade if Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses or an enemy enters Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down range.
Blitzcrank.build: Blitzcrank’s main damage is magic, and Rell has low magic resistance early, so buy Null-Magic Mantle first. Choose Mercury’s Treads. Rush Spirit Visage if the enemy team also deals mostly magic damage, and consider Banshee’s Veil if one engage ability is the problem.
Blitzcrank.escape: The moment Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses is your chance to engage. You can also close the distance with Rell E Full Tilt and W Ferromancy: Crash Down when Blitzcrank is out of mana and can’t use his grab. Blitzcrank has no skill that creates distance, so once you’re on him, lock him down with Rell Q Shattering Strike and R Magnet Storm.
Blitzcrank.fight: Trade right after Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses or when he’s low on mana. Engage with your team using Rell E Full Tilt, knock him up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, then weave in basic attacks in heavy armor to maintain Rell P Break the Mold stacks. When Blitzcrank P Mana Barrier appears, break it with Rell Q Shattering Strike.
Blitzcrank.phase: Later in the game, you have no way to get out after engaging, so don’t go in alone.
Blitzcrank.teamfight: When your team is ready to follow and at least two enemies are in Rell R Magnet Storm range, knock them up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, then pull them together. Rather than only attacking Blitzcrank, move close to allies in the back and start the fight. If the enemies are spread out, delay your engage and stay in heavy armor in front of your carries to absorb the dive.
Blitzcrank.watch: Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab pulls the first target it hits, so avoid it by standing behind minions. If you’re pulled, Blitzcrank E Power Fist can knock you up, followed by the silence from Blitzcrank R Static Field. Blitzcrank R Static Field also destroys shields, so don’t rely on only Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down’s shield to survive.

Neeko.escape: The moment Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is down is your window to engage as Rell.
Neeko.build: Neeko’s main damage is magic, and Rell’s magic resistance is relatively low, so build a Null-Magic Mantle early to survive. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots, and build Spirit Visage earlier if the enemy team also deals mostly magic damage.
Neeko.combo: When Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is down, close in with Rell E Full Tilt and knock her up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. Immediately stun her with Rell Q Shattering Strike, triggering the Rell E Full Tilt explosion, then pull her in with Rell R Magnet Storm so she can’t escape.
Neeko.fight: Build speed with Rell E Full Tilt to approach with your allies, then knock the target up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. Afterward, weave in basic attacks in heavy form to keep Rell P Break the Mold stacks up.
Neeko.laning: Pull the wave toward your turret and look for a chance to engage from the brush when Neeko comes within range of Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. Don’t stand on top of your allies to reduce the chance that Neeko E Tangle-Barbs roots you together. When you push the wave under the enemy turret and roam, activate Rell E Full Tilt before leaving, and account for the time it will take to return.
Neeko.phase: In the late game, it’s hard for Rell to get back out after engaging alone, so make sure your allies are ready to engage too.
Neeko.teamfight: If a transformed Neeko looks ready to close in, spread out from your allies so Neeko R Pop Blossom doesn’t hit you all. When your allies are ready to follow and at least two enemies are within range of Rell R Magnet Storm, knock them up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, then pull them together with Rell R Magnet Storm. If the enemies are spread out, don’t engage; stay in heavy form and block the path in front of your allied damage dealers.
Neeko.watch: Neeko E Tangle-Barbs grows and speeds up if it hits something first, making it easier to root allies behind the first target, so spread out. If an enemy transformed by Neeko P Inherent Glamour comes close, Neeko R Pop Blossom’s windup may be hidden, so spread out in advance. Don’t chase the clone from Neeko W Shapesplitter; focus on your original target.

Soraka.watch: If Soraka Q Starcall hits you, you’ll be slowed while Soraka heals and speeds up, so dodge it as you approach. Soraka E Equinox can silence and root you within its area, so use your engage ability before stepping into it. Soraka R Wish heals her allies in other lanes too, so keep it in mind when looking for a kill.
Soraka.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first to help you survive, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Soraka deals magic damage, so prioritize magic resistance. If the enemy team also focuses on magic damage, get Spirit Visage earlier; if fights go long, consider Grievous Wounds next.
Soraka.combo: Approach with Rell E Full Tilt alongside an ally, then knock Soraka up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. Stun her immediately with Rell Q Shattering Strike, which also triggers the explosion from Rell E Full Tilt. Follow with Rell R Magnet Storm to pull her in so she can’t escape.
Soraka.escape: Your chance to engage comes right after you see Soraka E Equinox used for poke or to push the wave. Close the gap with Rell E Full Tilt and Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down before stepping into the silence area. Soraka has no mobility, so once you’re on her, keep her locked down with Rell Q Shattering Strike and Rell R Magnet Storm.
Soraka.fight: As soon as Soraka E Equinox is down, use Rell E Full Tilt with an ally to speed in and close the gap. Knock her up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, then stun her with Rell Q Shattering Strike. Once in range, weave in basic attacks in Heavy Armor to maintain Rell P Break the Mold stacks. Dodge Soraka Q Starcall to prevent her healing and keep up the pressure.
Soraka.laning: Let the wave push toward your turret and look for Soraka to enter Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down range from the brush. Pressure the enemy ranged damage dealer and force Soraka to use Soraka W Astral Infusion, which also costs Soraka health.
Soraka.phase: Later in the game, it’s hard to get back out if you engage alone, so fight when your allies are ready to follow.
Soraka.teamfight: Target Soraka herself instead of focusing on an enemy receiving her healing. When your allies are ready to follow and at least two enemies are in range of Rell R Magnet Storm, engage with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down and pull them together. If the enemies are spread out, don’t engage; stay in Heavy Armor in front of your damage dealers to absorb the dive.

Bard.build: Hold on early with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads. Bard P Traveler’s Call and Q Cosmic Binding deal magic damage, and Rell has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Bard.combo: Approach with your team using Rell E Full Tilt, knock Bard up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, then stun him immediately with Rell Q Shattering Strike and trigger the detonation. Follow with Rell R Magnet Storm to pull him in; if Bard E Magical Journey is down, this sequence gives him less time to escape.
Bard.escape: The moment Bard E Magical Journey is down is your window to engage. If Bard Q Cosmic Binding is down too, close the distance with Rell E Full Tilt and W Ferromancy: Crash Down while avoiding the stun.
Bard.fight: After making Bard use E Magical Journey, engage with your team using Rell E Full Tilt and knock him up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. Once you’re on him, weave in basic attacks in heavy armor to maintain Rell P Break the Mold stacks as you keep trading.
Bard.laning: Pull the wave toward your turret and look for the moment Bard enters Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down range from the brush.
Bard.phase: Later in the game, you have no way to get out after engaging, so don’t go in alone.
Bard.teamfight: When your team is ready to follow and at least two enemies are in Rell R Magnet Storm range, knock them up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, then pull them together with Rell R Magnet Storm. If the enemies are spread out, don’t engage; stay in heavy armor in front of your carries and absorb their engage.
Bard.watch: Bard Q Cosmic Binding stuns if it hits a wall or a second target, so don’t stand with a wall behind you or in a straight line with an ally or minion. Watch for Bard E Magical Journey flank engages, and don’t unload your damage on targets caught in Bard R Tempered Fate, since they take no damage while affected.

Brand.build: Hold on early with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads. Brand’s damage is mostly magic, and Rell has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Rush Spirit Visage if his damage over time is a problem.
Brand.combo: When Brand W Pillar of Flame is down, speed in with your team using Rell E Full Tilt and knock him up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. Stun him immediately with Rell Q Shattering Strike to trigger Rell E Full Tilt’s detonation as well. Follow with Rell R Magnet Storm to pull Brand in and lock him down.
Brand.escape: Immediately after Brand uses W Pillar of Flame is your chance to engage. Don’t force an engage while Rell E Full Tilt is unavailable.
Brand.fight: Engage after Brand W Pillar of Flame is down if Brand is still within Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down range.
Brand.laning: Pull the wave toward your turret and look for the moment Brand enters Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down range from the brush. Brand E Conflagration can spread from burning minions, so approach from the side.
Brand.phase: Later in the game, Rell has a hard time getting out after going in alone, so make sure your team is ready to engage.
Brand.teamfight: Before engaging, spread out from your team to prevent Brand E Conflagration from spreading and Brand R Pyroclasm from bouncing; don’t stand beside an ally who is ablaze. When your team is ready to follow and at least two enemies are in Rell R Magnet Storm range, knock them up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, pull them together, and layer your team’s area damage. If the enemies are spread out, stay in heavy armor and block their approach in front of your carries.
Brand.watch: Brand P Blaze deals area damage based on maximum health, and repeated hits from his abilities build stacks that explode. Dodge his first attack, especially Brand W Pillar of Flame. If you’re ablaze, hide behind minions or move out of the path of Brand Q Sear’s projectile. When you see Brand R Pyroclasm being cast, spread out from your team to prevent the damage from bouncing between you.

Braum.build: Early on, Rell should get magic resistance first with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads. Braum’s main damage is magic, but his direct damage is low, so also account for the stun from Braum P Concussive Blows and the knockup from Braum R Glacial Fissure.
Braum.combo: Right before engaging, speed in with your team using Rell E Full Tilt, then leap down with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down to knock them up. Stun them immediately with Rell Q Shattering Strike to trigger Rell E Full Tilt’s detonation as well. Follow with Rell R Magnet Storm to pull them in and keep them from spreading out.
Braum.escape: Right after making Braum use W Stand Behind Me, close the distance with Rell E Full Tilt and W Ferromancy: Crash Down. If you see Braum R Glacial Fissure, first dodge its straight-line path, and don’t look for an engage while Rell E Full Tilt is unavailable.
Braum.fight: Right after making Braum use W Stand Behind Me is Rell’s chance to close the distance. Close in with your team using Rell E Full Tilt and knock enemies up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down; once in close, weave in basic attacks in heavy armor to maintain Rell P Break the Mold stacks.
Braum.laning: Stand behind minions to avoid the first hit of Braum Q Winter’s Bite, and pull the wave toward your turret. Engage from the brush when the target Braum is protecting enters Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down range.
Braum.phase: Later in the game, your range is short and you have no way to get out after engaging, so don’t go in alone.
Braum.teamfight: Engage when your team is ready to follow and at least two enemies are in Rell R Magnet Storm range. Use Rell R Magnet Storm immediately after knocking them up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down to pull them together and put them in range of your team’s area damage. If the enemies are spread out, stay in heavy armor in front of your carries and absorb the dive.
Braum.watch: Dodge Braum Q Winter’s Bite from behind minions. If Braum P Concussive Blows marks you, move out of range before enough stacks build up to stun you. When you see Braum R Glacial Fissure’s cast animation, sidestep its path and avoid the slow zone left behind. Braum E Unbreakable blocks your allies’ projectiles from the direction of its shield, so fight when the shield is down or your allies can attack from the side.

Heimerdinger.build: Hold on early with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads. Heimerdinger’s main damage is magic, and Rell has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first and rush Spirit Visage.
Heimerdinger.combo: Speed in with your team using Rell E Full Tilt, then knock him up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down and follow with Rell Q Shattering Strike to stun him. Rell E Full Tilt’s detonation triggers when Rell Q Shattering Strike hits; keep Heimerdinger pulled in with Rell R Magnet Storm.
Heimerdinger.escape: Close the distance with Rell E Full Tilt and W Ferromancy: Crash Down after Heimerdinger has used all his turret placement charges or a turret has just fired a strong shot.
Heimerdinger.fight: Don’t keep trading in front of Heimerdinger’s turrets; approach him from the side or through the brush. Once on him, weave in basic attacks in heavy armor to maintain Rell P Break the Mold stacks.
Heimerdinger.laning: Pull the wave toward your turret and look for the moment an enemy enters Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down range from the brush. Don’t force yourself to catch the wave within Heimerdinger’s turret range; wait outside until his grenade or turret placement charges have been spent. If it’s hard to close in and take him down, give up the lane and support another lane.
Heimerdinger.phase: Later in the game, Rell’s range is short and it’s hard to get out after engaging, so don’t go in alone.
Heimerdinger.teamfight: When your team is ready to follow and at least two enemies are in Rell R Magnet Storm range, knock them up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, then pull them together with Rell R Magnet Storm to hold them in your team’s area damage. While Heimerdinger R UPGRADE!!! is available, don’t group at one spot in front of an objective. If the enemies are spread out, don’t engage; stay in heavy armor in front of your carries.

Hwei.build: Hold on early with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads. Hwei’s damage is mostly magic, so build magic resistance first. Rush Spirit Visage if the enemy team also deals mostly magic damage.
Hwei.combo: Use Rell E Full Tilt to speed up and approach with your team, knock enemies up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, then stun them with Rell Q Shattering Strike and pull them together with Rell R Magnet Storm. If Hwei W Subject: Serenity’s shield is up, break it with Rell Q Shattering Strike.
Hwei.escape: Hwei has no mobility ability, so the moment Hwei E Subject: Torment is down is your chance to engage. Close the distance with Rell E Full Tilt and W Ferromancy: Crash Down, then lock him down with Rell Q Shattering Strike and Rell R Magnet Storm.
Hwei.fight: Close in with your team using Rell E Full Tilt right after Hwei E Subject: Torment is used for poke or wave clear. After knocking enemies up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, weave in basic attacks in heavy armor to maintain Rell P Break the Mold stacks.
Hwei.laning: Pull the wave toward your turret and look for the moment an enemy enters Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down range from the brush. When attempting a gank, check for the eye Hwei E Subject: Torment places; if one is there, change your route or send a minion ahead to trigger it first.
Hwei.phase: Later in the game, it’s hard to get out after engaging, so don’t go in alone.
Hwei.teamfight: When your team is ready to follow and at least two enemies are in Rell R Magnet Storm range, engage and pull them together. If Hwei E Subject: Torment is still available, whoever leads the engage could be forced back or rooted, so look for the moment right after he uses it. If the enemies are spread out, don’t engage; stay in heavy armor in front of your carries.
Hwei.watch: If you’re caught by Hwei E Subject: Torment’s snare or pull, you’re likely to take the follow-up attacks too. If Hwei’s first spell hits you, move immediately to avoid the second spell and the explosion from Hwei P Signature of the Visionary.

Janna.build: Weather the early game with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Janna’s damage is mostly magic, and Rell has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first if the enemy team also focuses on magic damage.
Janna.combo: Use Rell E Full Tilt to speed up and approach with an ally, then knock the target up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, stun them with Rell Q Shattering Strike, and pull them in with Rell R Magnet Storm. If Janna E Eye Of The Storm’s shield is up, time Rell Q Shattering Strike to hit and break that shield. Also consider saving Rell Q Shattering Strike to interrupt Janna R Monsoon if she can use it.
Janna.escape: When Janna Q Howling Gale is down, you have an opening to engage with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. If Janna R Monsoon is down too, there’s less risk of being knocked away, so use Rell E Full Tilt to close the gap.
Janna.fight: Don’t focus damage on a target protected by Janna E Eye Of The Storm. Break the shield with Rell Q Shattering Strike or target someone else. After Janna Q Howling Gale misses, use Rell E Full Tilt to close in with an ally and knock enemies up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down; once in close, weave in basic attacks to keep Rell P Break the Mold stacks up.
Janna.laning: Pull the wave toward your allied turret and wait in a bush for Janna to enter Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down range. Pressure the ally Janna is protecting to make her use Janna E Eye Of The Storm, then look to engage after Janna Q Howling Gale and Janna W Zephyr miss.
Janna.phase: Rell is at her peak in the mid game, when her defensive items are coming together. In the late game, she has no way to escape after engaging, so don’t engage alone.
Janna.teamfight: When your allies are ready to follow up and at least two enemies are in Rell R Magnet Storm range, knock them up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, then pull them in with Rell R Magnet Storm. If Janna is behind an allied damage dealer and uses Janna R Monsoon to stop your engage, secure vision and look for an opening when she is separated. If the enemy team is spread out, don’t engage; stay in your armored stance in front of your allied carries and peel for them.
Janna.watch: Janna Q Howling Gale can interrupt Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down by knocking Rell up, so avoid the tornado’s path if you hear it from out of vision. Janna R Monsoon knocks away an engaging Rell, so save Rell Q Shattering Strike’s stun, if available, for the moment Janna uses R.

Karma.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Karma’s main damage is magic, and Rell’s magic resistance is on the low side, so build magic resistance first.
Karma.combo: When Karma W Focused Resolve is down, approach with Rell E Full Tilt and knock her up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. Follow with Rell Q Shattering Strike to stun her, then pull her in with Rell R Magnet Storm. If Karma E Inspire’s shield is about to come up, save Rell Q Shattering Strike and use it on the shield.
Karma.escape: When Karma W Focused Resolve is available, she can root Rell after Rell engages, so create distance to draw it out before going in. If Karma R Mantra empowered Karma E Inspire has shielded nearby allies, engage after the duration ends. Use Rell E Full Tilt and Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down to close the gap then.
Karma.fight: After Karma W Focused Resolve is down, use Rell E Full Tilt to speed up with an ally and close the gap. If Karma E Inspire’s shield comes up, break it with Rell Q Shattering Strike. Once in close, weave in basic attacks in your armored stance to keep Rell P Break the Mold stacks up.
Karma.laning: Pull the wave toward your allied turret and wait in a bush for Karma to enter Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down range. Avoid taking Karma’s poke for free, since it reduces Karma R Mantra’s cooldown, by positioning behind minions or outside her range. After engaging with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, continue the trade with basic attacks in your armored stance.
Karma.phase: In the late game, you have no way to escape after engaging, so don’t go in alone.
Karma.teamfight: Draw out Karma W Focused Resolve and engage after the shield from Karma R Mantra empowered Karma E Inspire expires. If the enemy team is spread out, block for your allied carries in your armored stance and peel for them against dives.
Karma.watch: Karma Q Inner Flame slows and deals area damage, so avoid it from behind minions or outside its range. If you’re hit by Karma Q Inner Flame empowered by Karma R Mantra, immediately walk out of the remaining area. If Karma W Focused Resolve connects, create distance to break the tether before it roots you.

Leona.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Rell has low magic resistance early, and Leona’s damage is mostly magic, so build magic resistance first. Choose your later resistances based on the damage type of the enemy carry dealing damage while Leona holds a target in place.
Leona.combo: After Leona E Zenith Blade is down, approach with Rell E Full Tilt and knock enemies up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. Immediately land Rell Q Shattering Strike to apply its stun and trigger Rell E Full Tilt’s explosion together, then pull enemies in with Rell R Magnet Storm. If the shield from Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down is still up, don’t rush to remount.
Leona.escape: The moment after you bait out Leona E Zenith Blade is your window to close the gap. If her stun tools, Q Shield of Daybreak and R Solar Flare, are down too, engage with Rell E Full Tilt and W Ferromancy: Crash Down. Don’t look for an engage while Rell E Full Tilt is unavailable.
Leona.fight: Don’t start trades focused on physical damage against Leona’s high early armor. After Leona E Zenith Blade is down, use Rell E Full Tilt to close in with an ally and knock enemies up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. Once in close, weave basic attacks in your armored stance to keep Rell P Break the Mold stacks up.
Leona.laning: Pull the wave toward your allied turret and look for the moment an enemy enters Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down range from a bush. Don’t let Leona get close enough to engage, even if she hasn’t used Leona Q Shield of Daybreak, and don’t stand directly in line with your ranged carry. While Leona W Eclipse is active, leave its blast radius so its defensive stats don’t last as long.
Leona.phase: In the late game, it’s hard to get back out after engaging, so don’t engage alone.
Leona.teamfight: When your allies are ready to follow up and at least two enemies are in Rell R Magnet Storm range, knock them up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, then pull them in with R. If the enemy team is spread out, stay in your armored stance in front of your allied carries and peel for them against dives. If Leona P Sunlight marks you, that signals incoming follow-up damage from the enemy, so back off immediately.
Leona.watch: Leona E Zenith Blade pierces in a straight line and pulls her to the last champion hit, so don’t stand in a line with your allies. When Leona W Eclipse is active, get out of range before it explodes. When the marker for Leona R Solar Flare appears, move sideways to avoid the stun at its center.

Lux.build: Weather the early game with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Lux’s main damage is magic, and Rell’s magic resistance is on the low side, so build magic resistance first. If the enemy team also focuses on magic damage, buy Spirit Visage earlier; if a single burst of damage is the problem, consider Banshee's Veil.
Lux.combo: After Lux Q Light Binding misses, close in with Rell E Full Tilt and knock her up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, then stun her with Rell Q Shattering Strike. Rell E Full Tilt’s explosion triggers when the following Rell Q Shattering Strike hits first. Follow up with Rell R Magnet Storm so Lux can’t escape.
Lux.escape: Your chance to engage is right after baiting out and dodging Lux Q Light Binding. Lux has no ability to create distance on her own, so close the gap then with Rell E Full Tilt and Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down.
Lux.fight: Right after dodging Lux Q Light Binding, use Rell E Full Tilt to approach with an ally and knock enemies up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. Once in close, follow with Rell Q Shattering Strike to continue the crowd control with a stun, and weave in basic attacks in your armored stance to keep Rell P Break the Mold stacks up. If Lux W Prismatic Barrier’s shield is up, land Rell Q Shattering Strike to break it.
Lux.laning: Don’t stand in a line with your allies. Lux Q Light Binding roots the first two enemies it hits, so standing behind an ally alone won’t let you dodge it. Pull the wave toward your allied turret and, from the brush, target Lux when she enters Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down range.
Lux.phase: In the late game, account for your short range and limited means of escape after engaging; don’t go in alone.
Lux.teamfight: Don’t approach grouped with your allies, so Lux E Lucent Singularity doesn’t block all of you together. When your allies are ready to follow up and at least two enemies are in Rell R Magnet Storm range, knock them up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, then pull them in with Rell R Magnet Storm. If the enemy team is spread out, delay the engage and peel in front of your allied carries in your armored stance.
Lux.watch: If Lux Q Light Binding hits you, it’s easy to get hit by her follow-up spells in quick succession, so bait out and dodge Q before engaging. Leave the area affected by Lux E Lucent Singularity, and dodge Lux R Final Spark’s red targeting line by moving sideways. If you’re hit by a Lux spell, create distance so you don’t also get hit by a basic attack that triggers Lux P Illumination.

Maokai.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Rell starts with low magic resistance, so if the enemy team also focuses on magic damage, build magic resistance first and buy Spirit Visage earlier. Consider Banshee's Veil if incoming burst damage is the problem.
Maokai.combo: When Maokai W Twisted Advance is down, close in with Rell E Full Tilt and knock him up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, then stun him with Rell Q Shattering Strike. Rell E Full Tilt’s explosion triggers on whichever hits first, your next basic attack or Rell Q Shattering Strike, so use Rell Q Shattering Strike right after the knockup. Follow with Rell R Magnet Storm if you can catch multiple enemies.
Maokai.escape: The moment after you bait out Maokai W Twisted Advance, his only mobility tool, is your window to engage. Save Rell’s spells and basic attacks while he dashes, then follow up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down and Rell Q Shattering Strike after he lands. Don’t start a fight in a narrow passage where Maokai R Nature's Grasp is approaching.
Maokai.fight: Right after Maokai W Twisted Advance is down, use Rell E Full Tilt to close in with an ally and knock him up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. If you keep hitting Maokai with spells, Maokai P Sap Magic’s healing comes back sooner, so focus your trading spells on the enemy carry.
Maokai.laning: Pull the wave toward your allied turret and, from a bush without Maokai E Sapling Toss, target an enemy who enters Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down range. While Maokai W Twisted Advance is ready, don’t enter range near bushes. When roaming, push the wave into the enemy turret, then activate Rell E Full Tilt and move, accounting for the time it will take to return.
Maokai.phase: In the late game, you have no way to return after engaging, so don’t go in alone.
Maokai.teamfight: Fight in open terrain where there’s room to dodge Maokai R Nature's Grasp sideways. When your allies are ready to follow up and at least two enemies are in Rell R Magnet Storm range, knock them up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, then pull them together. If the enemy team is spread out, don’t engage; stay in your armored stance in front of your allied carries and peel for them against dives.
Maokai.watch: Maokai W Twisted Advance makes him untargetable while dashing, so don’t use Rell Q Shattering Strike or basic attacks before he lands. Avoid bushes seeded by Maokai E Sapling Toss, and if a sapling attaches to you, lure it toward a minion or monster rather than an ally. If Maokai R Nature's Grasp comes from far away, dodge perpendicular to its path.

Milio.build: Weather the early game with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Rell’s magic resistance is on the low side, and Milio P Fired Up! and Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick deal magic damage, so build magic resistance first. Choose later resistance items based on the enemy carry’s damage type, and get anti-healing if the healing from Milio W Cozy Campfire and Milio R Breath of Life is a problem.
Milio.combo: When Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down, use Rell E Full Tilt to approach with an ally, then knock him up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. Follow with Rell Q Shattering Strike to stun him and Rell R Magnet Storm to pull enemies together. If you see Milio E Warm Hugs’ shield, time Rell Q Shattering Strike to hit then and break the shield too.
Milio.escape: The moment after Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down is your chance to engage. Milio has no mobility, so close the gap with Rell E Full Tilt and Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, then lock him down with Rell Q Shattering Strike and Rell R Magnet Storm. Even if Milio R Breath of Life is available, it can’t remove Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down’s knockup.
Milio.fight: When Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down, use Rell E Full Tilt to close in with an ally and knock him up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. If Milio E Warm Hugs’ shield comes up, break it with Rell Q Shattering Strike and follow with the stun. Once you’re on him, weave in basic attacks in your armored stance to keep Rell P Break the Mold stacks up.
Milio.laning: Pull the wave toward your allied turret and wait in a bush for Milio to enter Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down range. Delay fights while Milio W Cozy Campfire extends the enemy ranged carry’s attack range, and pressure Milio’s mana with poke in the early game to take control of the wave.
Milio.phase: Rell peaks in the mid game as her defensive items come together, so start fights with your allies. Milio’s team gets stronger as the game goes on, and late game Rell has a hard time getting out after engaging, so avoid engaging alone.
Milio.teamfight: When your allies are ready to follow up and at least two enemies are in Rell R Magnet Storm range, knock them up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, then pull them together. If you can reach Milio himself, look for an angle to take him out first and cut off the enemy team’s healing support. If the enemy team is spread out, delay the engage and peel in front of your allied carries in your armored stance.
Milio.watch: Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick knocks back the first enemy it hits, so don’t rush your engage if he hasn’t used it yet. Delay front line fights while Milio W Cozy Campfire extends the enemy ranged carry’s attack range. Milio R Breath of Life removes immobilizing effects but doesn’t remove knockups.

Morgana.build: Build a Null-Magic Mantle early to survive, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Morgana’s main damage is magic, and Rell’s magic resistance is relatively low, so build magic resistance first. If the enemy team also deals mostly magic damage, build Spirit Visage earlier.
Morgana.combo: When Morgana E Black Shield is down, close in with Rell E Full Tilt, knock her up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, then stun her with Rell Q Shattering Strike. Follow with Rell R Magnet Storm to pull enemies together and create an opening for your allies to attack. If Morgana E Black Shield comes up first, Rell Q Shattering Strike can break it, so time the ability for that moment.
Morgana.escape: An engage window opens when Morgana Q Dark Binding misses and Morgana E Black Shield is down. Morgana has no ability to create distance on her own, so close the gap with Rell E Full Tilt and Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down.
Morgana.fight: Dodge Morgana Q Dark Binding, then use Rell E Full Tilt to approach with your allies when Morgana E Black Shield is down. After closing in with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, weave in basic attacks in heavy form to keep Rell P Break the Mold stacks up as you continue the trade.
Morgana.laning: Pull the wave toward your turret and keep minions between you to dodge Morgana Q Dark Binding. Look for a chance to engage when Morgana comes within range of Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down from the brush.
Morgana.phase: In the late game, it’s hard to get out after engaging alone, so go in only when your allies can follow.
Morgana.teamfight: Engage when Morgana E Black Shield is down and your allies are ready to follow. Right after knocking enemies up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, if at least two enemies are within range of Rell R Magnet Storm, pull them together so your allies’ area damage can hit. If the enemies are spread out, don’t engage; stay in heavy form in front of your allied damage dealers and absorb the dive.
Morgana.watch: If Morgana Q Dark Binding hits, Morgana W Tormented Shadow and follow-up attacks will come next, so dodge by keeping minions between you. When your health is low, don’t stay on Morgana W Tormented Shadow or retreat onto it. If Morgana R Soul Shackles catches you, use Rell E Full Tilt or Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down to get out of range before it stuns you.

Nami.build: Weather the early game with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Nami’s damage is mostly magic, and Rell’s magic resistance is on the low side, so build magic resistance first.
Nami.combo: When Nami Q Aqua Prison misses, use Rell E Full Tilt to speed up and approach with an ally. Immediately after knocking her up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, stun her with Rell Q Shattering Strike and pull enemies in with Rell R Magnet Storm. Rell E Full Tilt’s explosion triggers when Rell Q Shattering Strike hits first.
Nami.escape: Nami has no mobility, so the moment after Nami Q Aqua Prison misses is your chance to close the gap. Dodge Nami R Tidal Wave sideways, and save Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down for the Nami Q Aqua Prison that may follow.
Nami.fight: Target Nami right after Nami Q Aqua Prison misses. Use Rell E Full Tilt to approach with an ally and knock her up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. Once you’re on her, weave in basic attacks in your armored stance to keep Rell P Break the Mold stacks up.
Nami.laning: Pull the wave toward your allied turret and secure vision in the bushes, then wait for Nami to enter Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down range. Nami has relatively low health and no mobility, so look for an engage on her rather than the ranged carry.
Nami.phase: In the late game, Rell has a hard time getting back out after engaging alone, so only start a fight when your allies can follow up.
Nami.teamfight: Engage when your allies are ready to follow up and at least two enemies are in Rell R Magnet Storm range. If the enemy team is spread out, stay in your armored stance in front of your allied carries and peel for them against dives.
Nami.watch: Nami Q Aqua Prison stuns but falls slowly, so dodge sideways when you see it coming. Dodge Nami R Tidal Wave sideways as soon as you see it, and save Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down for the Nami Q Aqua Prison that may follow. Don’t fight head-on against a target affected by Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing; re-engage after its duration ends.

Nautilus.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Nautilus’s main damage is magic, and Rell’s early magic resistance is low, so build magic resistance first. If the enemy team also deals mostly magic damage, build Spirit Visage earlier; if a single engage is the problem, consider Banshee's Veil.
Nautilus.combo: When Nautilus Q Dredge Line is down, build speed with Rell E Full Tilt and engage with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down to knock him up. Then stun him with Rell Q Shattering Strike while breaking Nautilus W Titan's Wrath shield, and pull him in with Rell R Magnet Storm. The Rell E Full Tilt explosion triggers on whichever hits first: your next basic attack or Rell Q Shattering Strike.
Nautilus.escape: Your chance to engage comes right after you bait out Nautilus Q Dredge Line. Close the gap with Rell E Full Tilt and Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, then stun him with Rell Q Shattering Strike. Nautilus P Staggering Blow roots you when his basic attack hits, so don’t stay in his basic attack range after trading.
Nautilus.fight: Right after Nautilus Q Dredge Line misses, use Rell E Full Tilt to close in with your allies and knock him up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. When Nautilus W Titan's Wrath shield comes up, break it and stun him with Rell Q Shattering Strike. After closing in, weave in basic attacks in heavy form to keep Rell P Break the Mold stacks up.
Nautilus.laning: Pull the wave toward your turret and look for a chance to engage from the brush when Nautilus comes within range of Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. Stand with minions between you to block Nautilus Q Dredge Line. To roam, push the wave under the enemy turret, then activate Rell E Full Tilt and leave right away.
Nautilus.phase: In the late game, you have no way to get out after engaging, so don’t go in alone before your allies are ready to follow.
Nautilus.teamfight: When your allies are ready to follow and at least two enemies are within range of Rell R Magnet Storm, knock them up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, then pull them together with your ultimate. If Nautilus has Nautilus R Depth Charge, don’t stand on top of your allies along the engage path. If the enemies are spread out, don’t engage; stay in heavy form in front of your allied damage dealers and absorb the engage.
Nautilus.watch: Nautilus Q Dredge Line is his main engage, so dodge it by keeping minions between you. Nautilus P Staggering Blow roots you when his basic attack hits, so don’t stay in basic attack range after trading. If Nautilus uses Nautilus E Riptide right next to you, stay in place until the wave ends. When Nautilus has Nautilus R Depth Charge, don’t stand on top of your allies.

Pantheon.build: Pantheon Q Comet Spear, W Shield Vault, and E Aegis Assault deal mostly physical damage, so buy Plated Steelcaps and build armor first. If Pantheon’s basic attacks and attack speed are a threat, build Frozen Heart to lower his attack speed and protect your allied damage dealers. Pantheon W Shield Vault deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid stacking a lot of health alone.
Pantheon.combo: Build speed with Rell E Full Tilt to approach with your allies, then knock Pantheon up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. Immediately hit him with Rell Q Shattering Strike to stun him and trigger the Rell E Full Tilt explosion, then hold him in place with Rell R Magnet Storm. If Pantheon E Aegis Assault is active and facing you, change your angle to deal damage or wait for it to end.
Pantheon.escape: Your engage window is after Pantheon W Shield Vault is down and before Pantheon R Grand Starfall comes back up. If only one of the two is down, he can escape with the other mobility ability, so check whether both have been used before closing the gap with Rell E Full Tilt and Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. Once you’re in, follow with Rell Q Shattering Strike and Rell R Magnet Storm to leave him fewer chances to escape.
Pantheon.fight: Wait outside Pantheon W Shield Vault range, then use Rell E Full Tilt to close in with your allies once it is down. Knock him up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, stun him with Rell Q Shattering Strike, then weave in basic attacks in heavy form to keep Rell P Break the Mold stacks up. If Pantheon E Aegis Assault is facing you, wait for it to end or angle your attack from the side.
Pantheon.laning: Don’t trade blows with Pantheon early. Pull the wave toward your turret and look for a chance to engage from the brush when he comes within range of Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. When Pantheon uses Pantheon Q Comet Spear to poke, stand with minions between you.
Pantheon.phase: Pantheon’s influence falls off in the late game, but it’s still dangerous for Rell to engage alone at short range, so move with your allies.
Pantheon.teamfight: When your allies are ready to follow and at least two enemies are within range of Rell R Magnet Storm, knock them up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, then pull them together with Rell R Magnet Storm. Pantheon can use Pantheon W Shield Vault to reach your allied damage dealers, so if the enemies are spread out, don’t engage first; stay in heavy form and block the path in front of your damage dealers. When you see the landing indicator for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, move out of the landing area.
Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault is a targeted stun, so you can’t dodge it once you’re in range. When you see the landing indicator for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, walk out of the landing area.

Pyke.build: Buy Plated Steelcaps and build armor to prepare for Pyke’s damage. Pyke stacks armor penetration, so also build health to stay above the threshold for Pyke R Death From Below.
Pyke.combo: Just before engaging, build speed with Rell E Full Tilt alongside your allies, then knock Pyke up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. Immediately hit him with Rell Q Shattering Strike to stun him and trigger the Rell E Full Tilt explosion, then hold him with Rell R Magnet Storm to give your allies time to follow up.
Pyke.escape: Your engage window opens right after you dodge Pyke E Phantom Undertow. If Pyke R Death From Below is also down, close the gap with Rell E Full Tilt and Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down before it comes back up. Follow with Rell Q Shattering Strike and Rell R Magnet Storm to keep Pyke from escaping.
Pyke.fight: If you dodge Pyke E Phantom Undertow to the side, use the window when his engage and escape tools are down to close in with Rell E Full Tilt alongside your allies. Knock him up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, stun him with Rell Q Shattering Strike, and weave in basic attacks during the close fight to keep Rell P Break the Mold stacks up.
Pyke.laning: Pull the wave toward your turret and look for a chance to engage from the brush when Pyke comes within range of Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. If Pyke retreats after trading, maintain vision to prevent Pyke P Gift of the Drowned Ones from healing him. Use a Control Ward to cover the brush entrance and limit Pyke W Ghostwater Dive’s approach angles.
Pyke.phase: In the late game, don’t go deep alone; stand in front of the allied damage dealers Pyke is likely to target and absorb his engage.
Pyke.teamfight: When your allies are ready to follow and at least two enemies are within range of Rell R Magnet Storm, engage and pull them together. If the enemies are spread out, stay up front to protect your allied damage dealers and absorb Pyke’s engage. Stand apart from low-health allies to reduce the chance that Pyke R Death From Below hits repeatedly.
Pyke.watch: If Pyke Q Bone Skewer pulls you in, Pyke E Phantom Undertow can follow up with a stun, so watch your distance. Dodge Pyke E Phantom Undertow by moving to the side of its dash path. If you see a shark shadow beneath your feet, Pyke W Ghostwater Dive is close, so retreat toward your allies or turret. Watch out for Pyke R Death From Below when your health is low.

Rakan.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Rakan’s damage is mostly magic and Rell’s magic resistance is relatively low, so build magic resistance first.
Rakan.combo: Use Rell E Full Tilt to approach with your allies, then knock Rakan up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down and stun him with Rell Q Shattering Strike to trigger the explosion. Follow with Rell R Magnet Storm to pull enemies together. If Rakan’s shield is up, time Rell Q Shattering Strike to break it too.
Rakan.escape: Your window to close the gap opens right after you dodge or bait out Rakan W Grand Entrance. If Rakan R The Quickness hasn’t reached you yet, start the engage with crowd control from Rell Q Shattering Strike or Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down.
Rakan.fight: Trade right after Rakan P Fey Feathers’ shield is removed. If the shield is still up, save Rell Q Shattering Strike until it appears, then hit him to break it. After closing in, weave in basic attacks in heavy form.
Rakan.laning: Pull the wave toward your turret and look for a chance to engage from the brush when Rakan comes within range of Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. Catch him when he’s alone, away from his allies, warding or moving, since he can’t use Rakan E Battle Dance on an ally then.
Rakan.teamfight: Right after Rakan W Grand Entrance lands, interrupt his movement in and out with Rell Q Shattering Strike or Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. When your allies are ready to follow and at least two enemies are within range of Rell R Magnet Storm, engage and pull them together. If the enemies are spread out, stay in heavy form in front of your allied damage dealers and absorb the dive.
Rakan.watch: Rakan W Grand Entrance shows its landing point in advance, so move to the side when he starts the dash to dodge the knockup. When Rakan R The Quickness is active, it’s hard to escape on foot, so don’t stand in a line and stop him before he reaches you with Rell Q Shattering Strike or Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down.

Renata.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Renata Glasc’s damage is mostly magic and Rell’s magic resistance is relatively low, so prioritize magic resistance.
Renata.combo: Build speed with Rell E Full Tilt to approach alongside your allies, then knock Renata Glasc up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. If Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program shield comes up, break it and stun her with Rell Q Shattering Strike, then pull enemies together with Rell R Magnet Storm. The Rell E Full Tilt explosion triggers with Rell Q Shattering Strike when you hit it right after Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down.
Renata.escape: Renata Glasc has no mobility ability of her own, so close the gap with Rell E Full Tilt and Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down after Renata Glasc Q Handshake is down. If Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover is available, don’t engage in a line with your allies.
Renata.fight: Renata Glasc has no mobility ability of her own, so target her when you have a chance to close the gap. Use Rell E Full Tilt to close in with your allies and knock her up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. After closing in, weave in basic attacks in heavy form to keep Rell P Break the Mold stacks up. When Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program shield comes up, break it with Rell Q Shattering Strike.
Renata.laning: Pull the wave toward your turret and look for a chance to engage from the brush when Renata Glasc comes within range of Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. Don’t force an engage while Rell E Full Tilt is down.
Renata.phase: In the late game, you have no way to get back out after engaging, so don’t engage alone.
Renata.teamfight: While Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover is available, engage with space between you and your allies. When your allies are ready to follow and at least two enemies are within range of Rell R Magnet Storm, knock them up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, then pull them together with Rell R Magnet Storm. If the enemies are spread out, don’t engage; stay in heavy form and block the path in front of your allied damage dealers.
Renata.watch: Renata Glasc Q Handshake roots you, and the throw can stun your allies too, so dodge from behind a minion or your front line. When Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover is available, don’t engage while standing close to your allies. If you kill an enemy affected by Renata Glasc W Bailout, create distance together with your allies so that enemy can’t fully revive through a takedown.

Senna.build: Senna’s main damage is physical, so buy Plated Steelcaps and build armor first. When dealing with her basic attacks, build armor alongside health rather than stacking health alone. If the enemy team also relies on basic attacks, choose Frozen Heart.
Senna.combo: Approach with Rell E Full Tilt alongside an ally, then knock Senna up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down and stun her with Rell Q Shattering Strike. Follow with Rell R Magnet Storm to hold her in place; if Q lands right after the knockup, E’s explosion also hits. If a shield from Senna R Dawning Shadow is about to appear, save Rell Q Shattering Strike to break the shield.
Senna.escape: Senna has no ability that lets her create distance on her own, so when Senna W Last Embrace misses or is down, look for a chance to close in with Rell E Full Tilt and Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. Don’t force an engage by walking in while Rell E Full Tilt is down.
Senna.fight: When Rell E Full Tilt is available and your allies can close in with you, engage from the brush as soon as Senna enters Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down range. After knocking her up, stun her with Rell Q Shattering Strike, then weave in basic attacks in heavy form to maintain the armor and magic resistance reduction stacks.
Senna.laning: Let the wave push toward your turret and use the brush to get in range for Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. Usually, stay behind minions to avoid Senna W Last Embrace, but don’t stand in the straight line of Senna Q Piercing Darkness.
Senna.phase: Later in the game, Senna’s attack range and attack damage grow, so don’t engage alone with Rell’s short range.
Senna.teamfight: When your allies are ready to follow and at least two enemies are in range of Rell R Magnet Storm, knock them up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, then pull them together with R to set up your allies’ AoE. If Senna E Curse of the Black Mist appears, watch for camouflaged enemies to engage; retreat to an area where you have vision or use Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down in the mist. If the enemies are spread out, don’t force an engage; stay in heavy form in front of your allied damage dealers to protect them.
Senna.watch: Senna Q Piercing Darkness pokes in a straight line behind its target and also provides healing, so avoid the line between Senna and a front minion or ally. If Senna W Last Embrace hits you, move away from your allies when you see the mark, before the root takes hold. After Senna hits you once, back off so she cannot land a second basic attack or ability and collect Mist.

Seraphine.build: Build a Null-Magic Mantle early to survive, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Seraphine’s damage is mostly magic and Rell’s magic resistance is relatively low, so build magic resistance first. If the enemy team also deals mostly magic damage, build Spirit Visage earlier.
Seraphine.combo: Build speed with Rell E Full Tilt to close in alongside your allies, then knock Seraphine up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. Stun her with Rell Q Shattering Strike and pull her in with Rell R Magnet Storm. If Seraphine W Surround Sound shield comes up, time Rell Q Shattering Strike to break it.
Seraphine.escape: Seraphine has no mobility ability, so your engage window opens right after Seraphine E Beat Drop is used. Close the gap with Rell E Full Tilt and Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, then hold her with Rell Q Shattering Strike and Rell R Magnet Storm.
Seraphine.fight: Right after dodging Seraphine E Beat Drop, use Rell E Full Tilt to close in with your allies and knock her up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. Trade when Seraphine is alone, away from an allied ranged damage dealer. After closing in, weave in basic attacks in heavy form to keep Rell P Break the Mold stacks up.
Seraphine.laning: Pull the wave toward your turret and look for a chance to engage from the brush when Seraphine comes within range of Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. If she is separated from the ranged damage dealer, start a fight then.
Seraphine.phase: In the late game, it’s hard for Rell to get out after engaging alone, so only start fights when your allies are ready to follow.
Seraphine.teamfight: When your allies are ready to follow and at least two enemies are within range of Rell R Magnet Storm, knock them up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, then pull them together with Rell R Magnet Storm. Spread out to the sides from your allies so Seraphine R Encore can’t extend its range by hitting them. If the enemies are spread out, don’t engage; stay in heavy form in front of your allied damage dealers and absorb the engage.
Seraphine.watch: Seraphine E Beat Drop roots Rell if she is slowed and stuns her if she is immobilized.

Sona.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Sona deals mostly magic damage, and Rell has relatively low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance.
Sona.combo: Speed in with an ally using Rell E Full Tilt, then knock Sona up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. When a shield from Sona W Aria of Perseverance appears, break it and apply a stun with Rell Q Shattering Strike, then pull her in with Rell R Magnet Storm. If Q hits right after W, E’s explosion also hits.
Sona.escape: Your chance to engage is when Sona R Crescendo is down and before she uses Sona E Song of Celerity to speed up. Before Sona can escape with E, stop her movement with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down or Rell Q Shattering Strike, then hold her with Rell R Magnet Storm.
Sona.fight: When Sona steps forward to share her aura, approach with an ally using Rell E Full Tilt and knock her up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. When Sona W Aria of Perseverance applies a shield, break it and apply a stun with Rell Q Shattering Strike. After closing in, weave in basic attacks in heavy form to maintain Rell P Break the Mold stacks.
Sona.laning: Sona is weak early and spends mana to heal, so force trades when you can get on her. Let the wave push toward your turret and catch Sona as soon as she enters Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down range from the brush.
Sona.phase: Have Rell apply pressure first early on, while Sona has few Sona P Power Chord stacks. Later in the game, Sona’s healing and shielding become strong, and Rell has trouble getting out after engaging, so don’t go in alone first.
Sona.teamfight: When your allies are ready to follow and at least two enemies are in range of Rell R Magnet Storm, knock them up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, then pull them together with R. Separating Sona from an allied group can prevent Sona W Aria of Perseverance’s healing and shield from reaching nearby allies. Don’t stand in a line with your allies, or you may all be hit by Sona R Crescendo.
Sona.watch: Sona R Crescendo stuns everyone hit in a line, so if Sona steps forward, spread out to either side of your allies. Sona P Power Chord’s empowered basic attack deals bonus damage or slows depending on the ability she used beforehand, so create distance when she enters basic attack range.

Swain.build: Swain’s main damage is magic, and Rell has low magic resistance early, so buy Null-Magic Mantle first to help you survive. Choose Mercury’s Treads for boots, and get Spirit Visage earlier if the enemy team also focuses on magic damage. If you need to fight for a long time, prepare Grievous Wounds after building magic resistance.
Swain.combo: When Swain E Nevermove is down, approach with an ally using Rell E Full Tilt, then knock him up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. Immediately hit him with Rell Q Shattering Strike to stun him and trigger Rell E Full Tilt’s explosion, then pull him in with Rell R Magnet Storm.
Swain.escape: Swain has no mobility or escape ability, so your window to engage comes right after you dodge the returning wave of Swain E Nevermove. Close the gap with Rell E Full Tilt and Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, then stun him with Rell Q Shattering Strike.
Swain.fight: As soon as Swain E Nevermove is fully down, use Rell E Full Tilt with an ally to close in and knock him up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. Once in range, weave in basic attacks to maintain Rell P Break the Mold stacks. Don’t fight near Swain for long while Swain R Demonic Ascension is active; back off, then engage again.
Swain.laning: Let the wave push toward your turret and look for Swain to enter Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down range from the brush. Don’t force an engage while Rell E Full Tilt is down.
Swain.phase: Swain’s permanent health increases over time, so don’t take the same engage angle alone later in the game.
Swain.teamfight: When your allies are ready to follow and at least two enemies are in range of Rell R Magnet Storm, knock them up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, then pull them together with Rell R Magnet Storm. If Swain R Demonic Ascension is active, move out of range and engage again after it ends. If the enemies are spread out, don’t force an engage; stay in heavy form in front of your allied damage dealers to protect them.
Swain.watch: Swain E Nevermove travels out and back, so after dodging the first wave, stay out of its path until it disappears completely. Swain Q Death’s Hand fires overlapping bolts at close range, so watch out for its damage when approaching. When Swain R Demonic Ascension is active, move out of range and wait for it to end.

Taric.build: Taric mainly deals magic damage, so survive early with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads. If the enemy team also focuses on magic damage, get magic resistance first and build Spirit Visage earlier. If one engage is the problem rather than sustained damage, consider Banshee’s Veil.
Taric.combo: Approach with an ally using Rell E Full Tilt, then knock Taric up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down and follow with a stun from Rell Q Shattering Strike. If a shield from Taric W Bastion is present, time Rell Q Shattering Strike to break the shield as well. Follow with Rell R Magnet Storm to pull enemies together and make space for your allies to attack.
Taric.escape: Your chance to engage comes when Taric E Dazzle is down. Taric has no ability to create distance on his own, so close in with Rell E Full Tilt and Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, then keep him from escaping with Rell Q Shattering Strike and Rell R Magnet Storm.
Taric.fight: After dodging Taric E Dazzle, close in with an ally using Rell E Full Tilt and knock him up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. If a shield from Taric W Bastion appears, break the shield and follow up with a stun using Rell Q Shattering Strike. Once in range, weave in basic attacks in Heavy Armor to maintain Rell P Break the Mold stacks.
Taric.laning: Early on, don’t take extended melee trades while getting hit by Taric P Bravado’s empowered basic attacks. Let the wave push toward your turret and look for the moment Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down can reach him from the brush. If you bait out and dodge Taric E Dazzle, trade during its downtime.
Taric.phase: Later in the game, you have no way to get back out after engaging, so don’t go in alone.
Taric.teamfight: Engage and pull enemies together when at least two are in range of Rell R Magnet Storm and your allies are ready to follow. When Taric R Cosmic Radiance grants damage immunity, hold the enemies in place with Rell Q Shattering Strike, Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, and Rell R Magnet Storm, then focus your attacks once it ends. If the enemies are spread out, delay the engage and protect your damage dealers in Heavy Armor.
Taric.watch: Taric E Dazzle is a telegraphed stun, so dodge it by moving sideways. When Taric R Cosmic Radiance grants damage immunity, stop attacking and use Rell’s crowd control to hold them in place until it wears off.

Thresh.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle to help you survive and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Thresh’s ability damage is magic, and Rell has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Thresh.combo: When engaging, speed in with an ally using Rell E Full Tilt, knock Thresh up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, then stun him with Rell Q Shattering Strike and trigger the explosion. If a shield from Thresh W Dark Passage appears, time Rell Q Shattering Strike to break the shield. Follow with Rell R Magnet Storm to pull enemies together so they can’t escape.
Thresh.escape: Don’t engage immediately after dodging Thresh Q Death Sentence; look for an opening when Thresh W Dark Passage is also down. Then close the gap with Rell E Full Tilt and Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, and lock him down with Rell Q Shattering Strike and Rell R Magnet Storm.
Thresh.fight: Close the gap right after dodging Thresh Q Death Sentence to the side. It’s also a good time to trade when Thresh steps forward to collect souls. Once in range, weave in basic attacks to maintain Rell P Break the Mold stacks.
Thresh.laning: Let the wave push toward your turret and look for Thresh to enter Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down range from the brush. To roam, push the wave under the enemy turret, activate Rell E Full Tilt, and leave right after; also account for the time it takes to return to bot lane.
Thresh.phase: Later in the game, your range is short and it’s hard to get out after engaging, so don’t go in alone.
Thresh.teamfight: Engage when your allies are ready to follow and at least two enemies are in range of Rell R Magnet Storm. If Thresh throws Thresh W Dark Passage, either finish the target immediately or back off. If you’re trapped in Thresh R The Box, have your toughest ally choose a wall to break through so the rest can escape.
Thresh.watch: Thresh Q Death Sentence has a long cast animation, but being hit leaves you stuck in place. Move sideways as he raises his hook, then change direction again when stepping out to last-hit. Avoid the line between Thresh and his allies so Thresh E Flay can’t pull you toward allies.

Velkoz.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle to help you survive and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Vel’Koz’s main damage is magic, and Rell has low magic resistance, so get magic resistance first. Vel’Koz P Organic Deconstruction and Vel’Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray deal true damage, which resistance can’t reduce, so your priority is to avoid taking consecutive ability hits.
Velkoz.combo: When Vel’Koz E Tectonic Disruption is down, approach with Rell E Full Tilt, then knock him up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down and stun him with Rell Q Shattering Strike. Rell E Full Tilt’s explosion triggers when the follow-up Rell Q Shattering Strike hits. Layer Rell R Magnet Storm immediately after the knockup so Vel’Koz can’t scatter and escape.
Velkoz.escape: Your chance to engage comes right after dodging Vel’Koz E Tectonic Disruption. Vel’Koz has no mobility, so close the gap with Rell E Full Tilt and Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, then hold him with Rell Q Shattering Strike and Rell R Magnet Storm.
Velkoz.fight: After dodging Vel’Koz E Tectonic Disruption, close in with an ally using Rell E Full Tilt and start the fight by knocking him up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. After closing in, stun him with Rell Q Shattering Strike and weave in basic attacks in heavy form to maintain Rell P Break the Mold stacks. Vel’Koz E Tectonic Disruption can knock away enemies who are very close, so prepare a way to follow up with further crowd control before engaging.
Velkoz.laning: Let the wave push toward your turret and look for Vel’Koz to enter Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down range from the brush. Clear vision around the river and tri-brush to open a path to approach from the side, making it harder for Vel’Koz to step forward and poke. If you’ve been hit by consecutive abilities, back behind minions and let Vel’Koz P Organic Deconstruction stacks expire.
Velkoz.phase: Later in the game, Rell has no way back out if she engages alone, so only engage when your allies are ready to follow.
Velkoz.teamfight: When your allies are ready to follow and at least two enemies are in range of Rell R Magnet Storm, knock them up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, then pull them together to set up your allies’ AoE. If Vel’Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray starts, interrupt it first with crowd control from Rell Q Shattering Strike or Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. If the enemies are spread out, don’t go in first; stand in front of your allied damage dealers in Heavy Armor to protect them.
Velkoz.watch: Vel’Koz Q Plasma Fission splits to either side even if you dodge its main projectile, so don’t just move sideways; move toward Vel’Koz or behind where the beam passed. Vel’Koz E Tectonic Disruption can interrupt your engage if it hits, so dodge it before approaching. If you’ve been hit by consecutive abilities and Vel’Koz P Organic Deconstruction stacks have built up, back off and let the stacks expire. Interrupt Vel’Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray with crowd control as soon as it starts.

Xerath.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first to help you survive and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Xerath deals mostly magic damage, and Rell has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If the enemy team also focuses on magic damage, get Spirit Visage earlier; if one large burst is the problem, consider Banshee’s Veil.
Xerath.combo: When Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down, close in with Rell E Full Tilt and knock him up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. Immediately follow with Rell Q Shattering Strike to stun him and hit with Rell E Full Tilt’s explosion, then pull him in with Rell R Magnet Storm.
Xerath.escape: Xerath has no mobility, so your window to engage comes right after Xerath E Shocking Orb’s stun and Xerath W Eye of Destruction’s slow are down. Close the gap with Rell E Full Tilt and Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, then stun him with Rell Q Shattering Strike. Xerath can’t move while casting Xerath R Rite of the Arcane, so you can also engage on him then.
Xerath.fight: Close the gap as soon as Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down. Speed in with an ally using Rell E Full Tilt, knock him up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, then weave in basic attacks in Heavy Armor to maintain Rell P Break the Mold stacks.
Xerath.laning: Let the wave push toward your turret and look for Xerath to enter Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down range from the brush. Avoid the heavy damage from Xerath Q Arcanopulse as you hold out, and push the lane and call your jungler when Xerath is running low on mana. Don’t look for an engage while Rell E Full Tilt is down.
Xerath.phase: Later in the game, Rell’s range is short and it’s hard to get out after engaging, so don’t go in alone.
Xerath.teamfight: Engage when your allies are ready to follow and at least two enemies are in range of Rell R Magnet Storm. Immediately after knocking enemies up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, overlap it with Rell R Magnet Storm to pull enemies together and help your allies land AoE attacks. If the enemies are spread out, don’t engage; stay in Heavy Armor in front of your damage dealers to absorb the dive.
Xerath.watch: If Xerath E Shocking Orb stuns you, you can take the full follow-up, so be especially careful to dodge that shot. Xerath Q Arcanopulse passes through minions, so when you see him charging, change direction and move sideways. Watch out for the slow from Xerath W Eye of Destruction, and start dodging as soon as you see the cast animation for Xerath R Rite of the Arcane.

Zilean.build: Hold on early with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Zilean deals magic damage, so build magic resistance first. If the enemy team also deals mostly magic damage, get Spirit Visage earlier.
Zilean.combo: Activate Rell E Full Tilt just before engaging to gain speed with your allies, then knock Zilean up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. Immediately stun him with Rell Q Shattering Strike and pull him in with Rell R Magnet Storm. If Q hits right after W, E's detonation also lands.
Zilean.escape: Zilean has no mobility ability, so after he uses Zilean E Time Warp is your chance to get on him. If the first Zilean Q Time Bomb has attached, first move away from your allies and out of its blast radius. After avoiding the bomb combo, engage with your allies.
Zilean.fight: Zilean has no mobility ability, so when you get a chance to close the gap, use Rell E Full Tilt to approach with your allies and knock him up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. If you dive in alone, Zilean E Time Warp's slow and bomb combo can lock you down. Once you are on him, weave in basic attacks while in heavy armor to maintain Rell P Break the Mold stacks.
Zilean.teamfight: When your allies are ready to follow up and at least two enemies are within Rell R Magnet Storm's range, knock them up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, then pull them together with R. If the enemies are spread out, stay in heavy armor in front of your allied damage dealers and absorb the engage. If Zilean R Chronoshift is on your allies' target, switch to Zilean or be ready to finish the target after the effect ends.
Zilean.watch: Zilean Q Time Bomb stuns when two bombs attach to the same target. If the first bomb has attached, move away from your allies and out of its blast radius. If Zilean E Time Warp slows you, you are likely to get hit by the bomb combo, so do not engage alone.

Zyra.build: Zyra deals mostly magic damage, and Rell has low magic resistance early, so buy a Null-Magic Mantle first to increase your magic resistance. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots. If the enemy team also deals mostly magic damage, get Spirit Visage earlier; if one engage ability is the problem, consider Banshee's Veil.
Zyra.combo: When Zyra E Grasping Roots is down, use Rell E Full Tilt to approach with your allies and knock her up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. Immediately stun her with Rell Q Shattering Strike, detonate Rell E Full Tilt, then pull enemies together with Rell R Magnet Storm.
Zyra.escape: The moment after you draw out Zyra E Grasping Roots is your chance to engage. Zyra has no ability to create distance on her own, so close the gap with Rell E Full Tilt and Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, then lock her down with Rell Q Shattering Strike and Rell R Magnet Storm. If you see the cast indicator for Zyra R Stranglethorns, use Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down or Rell E Full Tilt to leave its area.
Zyra.fight: Dodge Zyra E Grasping Roots sideways, then engage when there are no plants nearby. Use Rell E Full Tilt to approach with your allies and knock her up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. While in heavy armor, weave in basic attacks to maintain Rell P Break the Mold stacks. If plants have gathered in an area, briefly back off and fight after they disappear.
Zyra.laning: Pull the wave toward your turret and wait in a brush for an opportunity when an enemy comes within Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down's range. Dodge Zyra E Grasping Roots first. If Zyra's abilities come your way as you go to step on a seed, back away, then return to clear it. Check a brush where Zyra has lingered with a Control Ward or an ability first.
Zyra.phase: In the late game, your range is short and it is hard to get out after engaging, so do not go in alone.
Zyra.teamfight: Avoid areas where Zyra has built up seeds and plants, and move the fight elsewhere. When your allies are ready to follow up and at least two enemies are within Rell R Magnet Storm's range, knock them up with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, then pull them together with R. If the enemies are spread out, stay in heavy armor in front of your allied damage dealers and absorb the engage.
Zyra.watch: If Zyra E Grasping Roots roots you, you are likely to keep taking plant damage. Dodge E by moving sideways at the edge of its range, and leave the area when you see the cast indicator for Zyra R Stranglethorns. Avoid fighting where plants have gathered.
